decision.rationale: The dispute is in time. TXN-008152 posted on 2026-09-04 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-27, which is 53 days later and inside the 120-day limit (time-limits). The posted amount is 9462 cents. Authorisation AUTH-008337 was approved for 8449 cents. The difference is 1013 cents. No receipt is attached, and the cardholder's figure of 84.49 EUR is a claim, not a receipt. The merchant, MER-000011 (Meadowlark Bistro), is a RESTAURANT. 20% of the authorised amount is 1689.8 cents, and the 1013-cent difference is within that. Under amount-restaurant-tip, a difference within this limit counts as an agreed tip, not a mismatch, so the dispute is declined.

proposed_actions.reason: The restaurant charged 10.13 EUR more than the 84.49 EUR you approved at the time of payment. Restaurants may add a tip of up to 20% of the approved amount (16.90 EUR here). This difference is within that limit and no receipt shows a different agreed amount, so it is treated as a tip.
